ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the length of line segment $AF$ is $13cm$, and points $B$, $C$, $D$, $E$ are sequentially on $AF$, with $AB=BC=CD$. Point $E$ is the midpoint of $DF$, and $CE=5cm$. Find the length of $BE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $AB=BC=CD=x\, \text{cm}$, thus $BD=2x\, \text{cm}$,\\
since $AF$ is $13\, \text{cm}$ long,\\
therefore $DF=13-3x$,\\
since $E$ is the midpoint of $DF$,\\
therefore $DE=\frac{1}{2}(13-3x)$,\\
since $CE=5$,\\
therefore $x+\frac{1}{2}(13-3x)=5$,\\
therefore $x=3$,\\
therefore $BC=3$,\\
therefore $BE=BC+CE=\boxed{8}\, (\text{cm})$.
